The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.

The Kumul Khanate, despite being an in-game "nation", by any scenario it doesn't exist, so the player only benefits by picking up Sinkiang and then taking the focus that releases them by a focus. Although being the only one of the many warlord nations that starts as a releasable and with a unique focus tree that shares with other warlords and in particular with fellow Ma warlord nations, makes up for an interesting conquest upon uniting all Turkic, Chinese and Mongolian lands under the Kumul Khanate flag.

In order to play as early as Kumul Khanate, is to pick the mentioned nation above as Sinkiang. In the early scenario, the player has to rush down in focuses that releases Kumul Khanate faster, as in ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. In a matter of technology, Kumul Khanate also inherits whatever Sinkiang gains from national focuses or by decision, if the player wishes to remain to play as Sinkiang a little longer just to have their technologies passable for Kumul Khanate gets them altogether. Considering that Sinkiang will have a brewing conflict with Khotan Ma, that little time wont be in their favor, therefore the player has to start as soon as possible. To make it easier, take the troops and dislocate them in the west or disband them in order to make the Kumul Khanate's campaign easier.

Once Sinkiang takes the focus ⟦0⟧, Sinkiang gets the event where the player can either supress the rebellion or switch tag and take the Kumul Khanate. In this point, Sinkiang finds itself in a war with two fronts: one with Khotan Ma and one with Kumul Khanate. Fortunately, as Kumul Khanate doesn't have any war plans against Khotan Ma, considering these two nations are waging war against Sinkiang. In spite of Kumul Khanate having more unit numbers compared to Sinkiang and balanced manpower, Kumul Khanate has green level troops, and it wouldn't stand a chance to fight with one Sinkiang unit. The strategy for Kumul Khanate is to rush down and take and annex all of Sinkiang before Khotan Ma does. Snaking, encircling and getting to the cities as quick as possible.

After Sinkiang has been annexed, Khotan Ma is the next target. Declare war on them, considering that their troops are not strong, therefore the strategy of snaking, encircling and taking the victory points applies here too. And Khotan Ma should be taken care of easily but tediously. Once ⟦0⟧ focus has been taken, then the Kumul Khanate now known as Yettishar marks its conquest to the east, as it has cores on the Ma Warlord clique nations. Should the player persist on the opposition path, then it unlocks the path of having cores on all of China.

Next to follow, if the Kumul Khanate has completed the warlord focuses and has picked either one, it would be easier to pick a fight with the Ma Cliques. Fighting the Ma's can be relatively tedious. Ningxia Ma and Gansu Ma being relatively easy to take down with the outmanoeuvring strategy. And Qinghai Ma would be a decent difficulty as they have more territory. Finally with Qinghai Ma last, by using the same outmanoeuvering and pin down attack strategies, the Kumul Khanate has no worry to hold on the Ma cores, as it cores every Chinese core so far. With this done and if the player has completed all of the warlord focuses of the Kumul Khanate, it is time to rush and go for Warlord subjugation in the generic Nationalist China focus tree. It would give a few wargoals for the player to strike and annex the warlords. Alternatively, go with the "Invite Foreign Investors" by rushing down all the way until you reach the "One China Policy".

Considering that the "Renegotiate the Unequal Treaties" focus is usually bypassed as the Kumul Khanate doesnt have the national spirit. If China and the rest of the East sided warlords are at war with Japan, it is a good opportunity to pick targets one by one. Be vary of the territories. Of the said nations. The Northeastern Army, in comparison to Sichuan and Communist China, is an easier target. Whereas the other two tend to increase their army, and utilize their mountainous terrain. In alternative to that, use the border conflict decision missions as an alternative to gain territory against the neighbors. Make sure to fix the supply routes, research trains and improve on division templates. Otherwise, if that proves to be obsolete, simply declare war on them by "One China Policy" focus, battle them in a preferable terrain. Or, research mountaineer divisions to fare better in the mountainous battlefields.

In addition, Kumul Khanate can ironically become the second most industrial power in China, only behind Chiang's China, thanks due to both its Warlord shared focus trees. Moreover, Kumul Khanate can also core the Central Asian nations, forming Turkestan and along with Mongolian lands, particularly Mongolia, Mengjiang and a few Soviet Mongol cores, allowing the Kumul Khanate to partly restore the Mongol Empire of yore.
The last achievement, "Genghis Khan't", is ironic given the background of the Kumul Khanate's rulers.
